Role description

The O&T Sales Lead OA plays a pivotal role in shaping and executing the Operating Unit’s strategy for the maintenance and repair business in Switzerland. The position ensures the local sales organization is well‑structured, aligned, and fully focused on delivering business priorities and OA performance targets. With a strong sales management background, the O&T Sales Lead OA drives disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and effective sales planning. Working closely with the OA Lead and the O&T Sales Lead OU, the role leads initiatives that strengthen sales performance, commercial effectiveness, and customer value.
Success in this position requires strong organizational insight and the ability to operate effectively within a complex matrix environment. The role collaborates daily with OT Leads, Service Sales Representatives, and T Sales Representatives to achieve sales objectives, optimize processes, and continuously improve operational efficiency.

Role Responsibilities

• Implementation of annual sales strategy for maintenance and repair business

• Functional leading of the Service Sales Representatives (Generalists, Account Manager, Recovery specialists, T-Sales Representative)

• Ensure disciplined pricing execution and annual price adjustments.

• Implement effective pipeline management, CRM adoption, and sales tools

• Strengthen lead generation through digital marketing and targeted acquisition

• Analyse market trends and derive actions to grow portfolio and service contracts

• Enhance contract product offerings and drive maintenance portfolio expansion

• Manage repair sales funnel, lead generation, and customer engagement

• Plan and execute T‑campaigns to support sustainable repair (T) growth

• Support rollout of international processes/tools to meet growth targets

Role KPI’s

• ABV / O‑Sales

• O‑Margin

• T‑Orders & T‑Margin

• Conversions, Cancellations & Recaptures

• Cancellation & Recapture Rates

• Net Gain / Erosion Rate

• Customer Satisfaction (CSAT, NPS)

• OO‑Subscriptions & Forecast Accuracy (FCST vs. Actual)

Qualifications, Competencies & Skills

• 5+ years’ experience in service and repair business

• Strong understanding of maintenance, repair, and sales processes

• Fluent in French and English. German is a plus

• Ability to lead cross‑functional teams

• Excellente communication and stakeholder management skills

• Strong analytical, strategic, and problem‑solving capabilities

• High customer focus and value‑driven mindset

• Results‑oriented with strong delivery record

• Collaborative team player in matrix environments

• Solid commercial acumen; skilled in sales process optimization

• Proficient with CRM and digital sales tools

• Strong coaching and development skills

• Competent in pipeline management, forecasting, and data‑driven decisions

Travel requirement - Up to 40% within Switzerland

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do.  We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. If you would like to learn more about environmental, social and governance (ESG) at Otis click here.

Become a part of the Otis team and help us #Buildwhatsnext!
Otis is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other protected class according to applicable law. To request an accommodation in completing an employment application due to a special need or a disability, please contact us at careers@otis.com.

La posizione assicura che l'organizzazione commerciale locale sia ben strutturata, allineata e completamente focalizzata sulla fornitura di priorità aziendali e obiettivi di performance OA. Il successo in questa posizione richiede una forte comprensione organizzativa e la capacità di operare efficacemente all'interno di un ambiente di matrice complesso. Il ruolo collabora ogni giorno con OT Leads, rappresentanti delle vendite dei servizi e rappresentanti delle vendite T per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita, ottimizzare i processi e migliorare continuamente l'efficienza operativa. ## Mansioni -
• Requisiti della strategia di vendita annuale per la manutenzione e la riparazione del business - Leader funzionale dei rappresentanti delle vendite dei servizi (Generalisti, Account Manager, Specialisti di recupero, Rappresentante di T-Sales) - Assicurare l’esecuzione dei prezzi disciplinati e gli aggiustamenti annuali dei prezzi - Gestione delle operazioni di implementazione, adozione CRM e strumenti di vendita - Rafforzare la generazione dei lead attraverso il marketing digitale e l’acquisizione mirata Se vivete in una città, è probabile che vi daremo un ascensore o un ruolo nel tenervi in movimento ogni giorno. Otis è l'azienda leader mondiale nella produzione, installazione e servizio di ascensore e scale mobili. Ci muoviamo 2,4 miliardi di persone ogni giorno e manteniamo circa 2,4 milioni di unità clienti in tutto il mondo, il più grande portafoglio di servizi del settore. Potete riconoscere i nostri prodotti in alcuni dei punti di riferimento più famosi del mondo, tra cui la Torre Eiffel, l'Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa e le Petronas Twin Towers! Siamo 72,000 persone forti, tra cui ingegneri, esperti di tecnologia digitale, vendite e specialisti funzionali, nonché tecnici di fabbrica e campo, tutti impegnati a soddisfare le diverse esigenze dei nostri clienti e passeggeri in oltre 200 paesi e territori in tutto il mondo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un team diversificato e globale con una comprovata eredità di innovazione che continua ad essere la base di una società veloce e performante. Quando ti unisci a Otis, diventi parte di un innovativo leader mondiale nel settore con un modello di business resiliente. Appartenerai a una comunità diversificata, affidabile e premurosa dove i tuoi contributi, e le competenze e le capacità che otterrai lavorare insieme al meglio e più luminoso, ci tengono connessi e all'avanguardia. Forniamo opportunità, formazione e risorse, che costruiscono leadership e capacità in Vendite, Field, Ingegneria e Progetti Maggiori e il nostro programma di studio dei dipendenti è un punto di orgoglio notevole, attraverso il quale Otis sponsorizza i colleghi a perseguire gradi o programmi di certificazione. Oggi, il nostro focus più che mai è sulle persone. Come azienda globale, alimentata da persone, mettiamo persone – passeggeri, clienti e colleghi – al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo guidati dai nostri valori che chiamiamo i nostri Tre Assoluti – privilegiando Sicurezza, Etica, Qualità in tutto ciò che facciamo. Se volete saperne di più su ambiente, sociale e governance (ESG) a Otis clicca qui. Diventa parte della squadra Otis e aiutaci #Buildwhatsnext! ## Contatto Otis is An Equal Opportunity Employer. Le poste s'assure que l'organisation de vente locale est bien structurée, alignée et entièrement axée sur l'atteinte des priorités opérationnelles et des objectifs de rendement du Bureau. Fort d'une solide expérience en matière de gestion des ventes, le Bureau du chef des ventes en O et T est responsable de la gestion disciplinée des pipelines, de la prévision exacte et de la planification efficace des ventes. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le chef de file de l'OA et le chef de file des ventes de F et T, le rôle dirige des initiatives qui renforcent le rendement des ventes, l'efficacité commerciale et la valeur client. Le succès dans ce poste exige une solide compréhension organisationnelle et la capacité de fonctionner efficacement dans un environnement matriciel complexe. Le rôle collabore quotidiennement avec OT Leads, Service Sales Representants et T Sales Representants pour atteindre les objectifs de vente, optimiser les processus et améliorer continuellement l'efficacité opérationnelle. ## Mansioni - Mise en oeuvre d'une stratégie de vente annuelle pour les entreprises d'entretien et de réparation - Chef de file fonctionnel des représentants des ventes de services (généralistes, gestionnaires de comptes, spécialistes de la récupération, représentant T-Sales) - Assurer une exécution rigoureuse des prix et des ajustements annuels des prix - Mettre en oeuvre une gestion efficace des pipelines, l'adoption de CRM et les outils de vente - Renforcer la production de plomb grâce au marketing numérique et à l'acquisition ciblée - Analyser les tendances du marché et élaborer des mesures pour accroître les contrats de portefeuille et de service - Améliorer les offres de produits contractuels et stimuler l'expansion du portefeuille de maintenance - Gérer l'entonnoir de vente de réparation, la production de plomb et l'engagement des clients - Planifier et exécuter des campagnes T pour soutenir la croissance durable de la réparation (T) - Soutenir le déploiement de processus/outils internationaux pour atteindre les objectifs de croissance ## KPI - ABV / O‐Sales - O‐Margin - T‐Orders & T‐Margin - Conversions, annulations & Recaptures - Annulation & Recapture Tarifs - Gain net / Erosion Taux - Satisfaction des Si vous vivez dans une ville, les chances sont que nous vous donnerons un ascenseur ou jouerons un rôle en vous faisant bouger chaque jour. Otis est le leader mondial de la fabrication, de l'installation et du service d'ascenseur et d'escalator. Nous déplaçons 2,4 milliards de personnes chaque jour et entretenons environ 2,4 millions d'unités clientes dans le monde, le plus important portefeuille de services de l'industrie. Vous pouvez reconnaître nos produits dans certains des monuments les plus célèbres du monde, y compris la Tour Eiffel, l'Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa et les tours jumelles Petronas ! Nous sommes 72.000 personnes fortes, y compris des ingénieurs, des experts en technologie numérique, des vendeurs et des spécialistes fonctionnels, ainsi que des techniciens d'usine et de terrain, tous engagés à répondre aux divers besoins de nos clients et passagers dans plus de 200 pays et territoires dans le monde. Nous sommes fiers d'être une équipe diversifiée et mondiale avec un héritage d'innovation éprouvé qui continue d'être le fondement d'une entreprise rapide et performante.
